maximum_permitted_stay: eVisa stay depends on selected visa type; conditional VOA permits up to 30 days.
passport_validity_rule: At least 6 months from arrival. Conditional VOA also requires any re-entry permit required by the traveller's nationality law.

proof_of_funds_rule: Bank statements for the previous two months; conditional VOA requires assured financial standing and sufficient maintenance funds.
accommodation_rule: Proof of accommodation for the stay or an invitation letter from a host/sponsor.
travel_insurance_rule: No mandatory travel-insurance requirement is stated in the reviewed official eVisa checklist.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No specific vaccination requirement is stated in the reviewed visa guidance.
transit_rule: Visa-required transit passengers may transit without a visa within 24 hours only with proof of onward journey and while remaining in the airport controlled area; same-day cruise visitors arriving in the morning and departing the same day are exempt.
application_channel: Apply online at https://evisa.immigration.gov.ag; pay by Mastercard or Visa. Obtain approval before travel unless eligible for conditional VOA.
application_fee: eVisa fee varies by type and is shown in the portal; conditional VOA USD 100 per passenger, including children.
processing_time: 7 working days; may extend to 15 days, exceptionally 30; apply at least 7 working days before travel.
required_documents: Passport biodata page; passport valid at least 6 months|Recent unaltered colour photo 45 x 35 mm, white background|Evidence of proposed journey into and out of Antigua and Barbuda|Accommodation proof or host/sponsor invitation|Bank statements for previous two months|Birth certificate|Recent police record (may be requested at visa-office discretion)|Immigration status in passport or residence permit, where applicable|Conditional VOA: qualifying valid US, Canada, UK or Schengen visa/residence card, return ticket and sufficient funds
official_immigration_source_name: Antigua and Barbuda Department of Immigration — Visa FAQs
cross_check_source_name: Antigua and Barbuda Department of Immigration — Visa Application Process
review_notes: Bangladesh is explicitly listed by the Antigua and Barbuda Consulate General in New York among Commonwealth nationalities requiring a visa; Bangladesh is not on the official visa-exempt list. The Department of Immigration FAQ permits holders of visa-required travel documents to apply for an eVisa, advises approval before travel, gives 7 working days processing (extendable to 15 days and exceptionally 30), and states the eVisa fee and stay vary by application type and are displayed in the portal. A separate Immigration VOA page provides a narrow conditional exception for travellers holding a valid US, Canada, UK or Schengen visa or residence card and meeting tourist-purpose, passport, return-ticket, funds and admissibility conditions: single entry up to 30 days, USD100 per passenger, non-extendable/non-convertible except medical cases. This is not general VOA; standard Bangladesh travellers should obtain an eVisa before travel. The online checklist specifies a 45x35mm recent colour white-background photo, journey evidence, accommodation/host, two months of bank statements, birth certificate, immigration status and a recent police record at visa-office discretion. Photo upload is required; fingerprints are taken on arrival. The FAQ's general warning against arriving without a visa applies to travellers not eligible for the specific conditional VOA exception.
